name: Turkey Burger Lettuce Wrap with Special Sauce, Blue Cheese & Mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup white wine vinegar
2 ½ tsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Place turkey, eggs, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; mix with your hands until well combined. Form the turkey mixture into 6 equal-sized patties, place on a plate, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
3 eggs
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are soft, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the mushrooms are cooking, place mayo, ketchup, Dijon, and cayenne in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the special sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp ketchup
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are done, add additional vinegar and cook until dry, 15-30 seconds. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add burger patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip patties, and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through.
Add burgers to the plate with the mushrooms and re-cover with foil.
Meanwhile, place additional oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate lettuce into leaves. Set aside two leaves per burger and chop (or tear) remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
Pile lettuce leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, on each plate; top with special sauce, burgers, mushrooms, blue cheese, and pickled onions. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled blue cheese
